item.text:
**Bottom Line**
- **Mixed, leaning positive on technocratic/evidence-based economic management.** In 2024 Jokowi’s government repeatedly used data, audits, and institutional coordination in macro, health, land, cyber, and tech policy. The main counterweight is not overt scapegoating so much as **patronage, dynastic bargaining, and some flagship-project persistence despite weak signals**.

**Accepted Claims**
- [Pemerintah dan Bank Indonesia Sepakati Tujuh Langkah Strategis Jaga Inflasi 2024](https://www.bi.go.id/id/publikasi/ruang-media/news-release/Pages/sp_261724.aspx) — Bank Indonesia — 2024-01-29: BI and the government agreed on coordinated inflation-control steps, including consistent monetary-fiscal policy; this is strong evidence of policy made through institutional analysis and correction, not slogans. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Laporan Kebijakan Moneter Triwulan I 2024](https://www.bi.go.id/en/publikasi/laporan/Pages/Laporan-Kebijakan-Moneter-Triwulan-I-2024.aspx) — Bank Indonesia — 2024-04-30: BI raised rates pre-emptively to defend rupiah stability and keep inflation in target, while using pro-market instruments to support growth. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia Economy Projected to Remain Resilient](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/06/24/indonesia-economy-projected-to-remain-resilient) — World Bank — 2024-06-24: the Bank credited Indonesia’s robust macro framework for attracting investment and explicitly recommended prudent, credible, transparent policy plus human capital and infrastructure spending. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia’s Climate Ambitions Gain Boost through World Bank-Supported Land Administration and Spatial Planning Reform](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/09/30/indonesia-s-climate-ambitions-gain-boost-through-world-bank-supported-land-administration-and-spatial-planning-reform) — World Bank — 2024-09-30: the reform package aimed to improve tenure security, simplify business licensing, reduce disputes, and increase productive investment; that is evidence of rule-based adjustment to known bottlenecks. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Indonesia Takes Decisive, Pioneering Action to Strengthen Multisource Collaborative Surveillance for Dengue](https://www.who.int/indonesia/news-room/item/30-07-2024-indonesia-takes-decisive--pioneering-action-to-strengthen-multisource-collaborative-surveillance-for-dengue) — WHO Indonesia — 2024-07-30: the government and WHO used multisource surveillance to guide preparedness and response to a fast-growing dengue threat; this is data-driven correction in a health domain. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [President urges BPKP to audit National Data Center governance](https://en.antaranews.com/news/317175/president-urges-bpkp-to-audit-national-data-center-governance) — ANTARA News — 2024-06-28: after the ransomware attack, Jokowi ordered a governance audit of government data centers rather than denying the failure; this is a corrective administrative response. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Kominfo tekankan media harus transparan dalam penggunaan AI](https://www.antaranews.com/berita/4093560/kominfo-tekankan-media-harus-transparan-dalam-penggunaan-ai) — ANTARA News — 2024-05-07: the ministry pushed transparency in AI use, indicating a rules-first, disclosure-oriented approach in a new technology domain. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Presiden Jokowi resmikan Plaza Seremoni Sumbu Kebangsaan di Ibu Kota Nusantara](https://presidenri.go.id/siaran-pers/presiden-jokowi-resmikan-plaza-seremoni-sumbu-kebangsaan-di-ibu-kota-nusantara/) — Presidential Secretariat of the Republic of Indonesia — 2024-08-14: the official line presented Nusantara as tangible progress, showing Jokowi still advancing a flagship development project. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.
- [Analysis-A decade of Jokowi: Indonesia’s democracy icon leaves illiberal legacy, critics say](https://theprint.in/world/analysis-a-decade-of-jokowi-indonesias-democracy-icon-leaves-illiberal-legacy-critics-say/2310394/) — Reuters via ThePrint — 2024-10-14: Reuters’ end-of-term framing says the decade ended with patronage, dynastic politics, and weaker state-institution integrity; that is the main negative signal against purely evidence-based policymaking. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.5`.
- [Protests across Indonesia as parliament delays change to election law](https://edition-prod-cf.sitemirror.cnn.com/2024/08/22/asia/indonesia-protests-election-law-intl/index.html) — Reuters via CNN — 2024-08-22: the proposed changes were seen as strengthening Jokowi’s influence and helping his son, which reads as patronage and rule-bending rather than neutral correction. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.5`.
- [Jokowi seeks Golkar takeover to retain decade-long influence](https://www.thejakartapost.com/indonesia/2024/03/20/jokowi-seeks-golkar-takeover-to-retain-decade-long-influence) — Reuters via The Jakarta Post — 2024-03-20: Reuters reported efforts to install a loyalist in Golkar and preserve influence after office, which undercuts a clean evidence-based/public-interest model. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.5`.
- [World Bank Group debars PT LPPSLH Konsultan](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/10/world-bank-group-debars-pt-lppslh-konsultan) — World Bank — 2024-07-10: the bank cited overbilling and improper hiring of a project official’s family member, a concrete favoritism/corruption signal inside development implementation. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.5`, `5B.6`.
- [Accelerating growth and attaining socioeconomic convergence: OECD Economic Surveys: Indonesia 2024](https://www.oecd.org/en/publications/oecd-economic-surveys-indonesia-2024_de87555a-en/full-report/accelerating-growth-and-attaining-socioeconomic-convergence_02e70f46.html) — OECD — 2024-11-26: OECD said Indonesia still had price controls, procurement hurdles, high administrative burdens, strong state involvement, and weak SOE governance; this suggests persistent structural protection and incomplete correction of market distortions. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.4`, `5B.5`.
- [Indonesian leader spends final weeks of his term in unfinished new capital](https://theprint.in/world/indonesian-leader-spends-final-weeks-of-his-term-in-unfinished-new-capital/2264249/) — Reuters via ThePrint — 2024-09-12: Nusantara still had delays, land issues, and weak foreign investment, which suggests a flagship project kept moving despite unresolved evidence of viability. IDs: `5B.7`, also `5B.6`.

**Search Gap**
- I did **not** find strong direct reporting that Jokowi’s 2024 economic policy relied on explicit scapegoating language. The negative evidence is mostly **patronage, dynastic maneuvering, restrictive regulation, and persistence with weakly validated flagship projects**, not overt blame-shifting.
- Direct evidence on **education** policy in 2024 was thinner than for macro policy, health surveillance, land administration, cyber response, and tech regulation.

**Overall Read**
- **Mostly evidence-based in macro and administrative management, but not cleanly insulated from patronage and legacy politics.**
